title: $100 a month into Costco since 2000 is now worth this
caption:
$100 every month into Costco since 2000.
Today that would be worth about {dca:COST:2000-01-03} (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: Could you put away $100 a month? 👇
sources: Costco price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: One hundred dollars a month, into Costco, starting in 2000.
Back then, Costco was a warehouse store.
Today, those monthly payments would be worth about {dca:COST:2000-01-03}.
Small, boring, every month. That's how wealth is built.
